models.name: todo_app_users
models.description: Registered user accounts with email and hashed password credentials for authentication. Serves as the primary actor identity for the TodoApp system. All user-specific data (todos, profiles, sessions) is owned and linked exclusively through this entity. Strictly used for authentication and authorization — no personal details like display name are stored here (handled in todo_app_profiles). Must not be referenced by any non-actor entities except through session, password reset, or email verification tables.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: User's unique login email address. Must be in valid email format. Used for authentication and communication.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: bcrypt-hashed password for authentication. Never stored in plain text. Used to validate login attempts.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was created. Immutable.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last update to the user account record (e.g., password change, logout). Updated on credential modifications.

models.name: todo_app_user_sessions
models.description: Refresh token sessions for authenticated users. Each session records login context (IP, referrer) and expires after 30 days of inactivity. Strictly owned by a single user. All sessions are append-only for audit trails.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_user_id
foreignFields.description: The user this session belongs to. {@link todo_app_users.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address from which the session was initiated.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Full URL of the page that initiated the login.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP referrer header of the login request, if available.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session will expire due to 30-day inactivity.

models.name: todo_app_user_password_resets
models.description:
Stores password reset tokens with expiration for user actors. This is a transient session entity created during password reset flows and automatically purged upon use or expiration. Each token is unique and bound to a single user. Reset tokens are invalidated after use or when expired, ensuring security and preventing replay attacks.

This table must not contain any user data beyond the actor reference. No profile, email, or other sensitive content is stored here — only the temporary token, its expiration, and audit timing.

{@link todo_app_users.id} is the sole foreign reference. This table has no user-visible UI, no edit capability, and is managed entirely by authentication flows.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_user_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the user requesting password reset. {@link todo_app_users.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Cryptographically secure, unique token used to validate the password reset request. Must be sufficiently long (e.g., 64+ random hex chars) and unguessable.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Exact datetime when this reset token expires and becomes invalid. Must be non-null and set at creation time (typically 1 hour from generation).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset token was issued. Required for audit and TTL management.

models.name: todo_app_user_email_verifications
models.description: Stores email verification tokens with expiration for user account registration. Each record is tied to one user and expires after a finite time. Used during account creation flow to validate that the user controls the email address. Once verified, the record is deleted; it is not retained for audit. Token must be unique and cannot be reused.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_user_id
foreignFields.description: References the user account that this verification token belongs to. {@link todo_app_users.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique, randomly generated verification token. Must be sufficiently long and random to prevent guessing. This value is not human-readable and is sent only via secure email channels.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: The exact timestamp when this verification token expires and becomes invalid. Tokens are not reusable after this point.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this verification record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this verification record was last updated (e.g., if token was refreshed).

models.name: todo_app_profiles
models.description: Stores the user's display name and profile audit timestamps. Owned exclusively by the authenticated user and never exposed to others. Only accessible under user's own session. Display name is a user-presentable identifier that can be edited at any time but remains private and non-shareable.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: User's public-facing display name. Must be unique within user's own scope (enforced by unique index). No other user can view, search, or reference this field.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when profile was created. Records the moment the user account was activated.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when display_name was last modified. Always updated on edit.

models.name: todo_app_todos
models.description: Primary todo entity storing title, description, start date, due date, completion status, and timestamps for each user-owned task. Each todo belongs exclusively to one user and is completely private. Users can create, view, toggle completion, edit, delete, restore, and permanently delete their todos. Edit history is handled by todo_app_todo_histories to maintain normalization.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_user_id
foreignFields.description: Owner user's {@link todo_app_users.id}. Required for data isolation and permission enforcement.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Title of the todo. Required field with minimum length constraint enforced at API level.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional detailed description of the todo. Can be empty.

plainFields.name: start_date
plainFields.description: Optional start date for the todo in ISO 8601 format. When present, used for sorting. Todos without start date appear last in ascending sort.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description: Optional due date for the todo in ISO 8601 format. When present, used for sorting. Todos without due date appear last in ascending sort.

plainFields.name: is_completed
plainFields.description: Completion status of the todo. Default is false (incomplete). Toggle operation flips this value atomically.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo was created. Immutable. Used as default sort field (newest first).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo was last updated (including toggle or edit). Updated on every change.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. If null, todo is active and visible in main list. If set, todo is in trash and hidden from main list.

models.name: todo_app_todo_histories
models.description: Stores historical record of every edit made to a todo item. Each entry captures the before and after values of changed fields (title, description, startDate, dueDate) along with the precise timestamp of the edit. All history entries are owned exclusively by the todo they reference and are never visible to users other than the todo's owner. History is accessed only through the parent todo and is automatically purged when the associated todo is permanently deleted.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_todo_id
foreignFields.description: The todo that was edited. {@link todo_app_todos.id}.

plainFields.name: edited_at
plainFields.description: The exact timestamp when this edit occurred. Always recorded in UTC. Used for sorting history from most recent to oldest.

plainFields.name: before_title
plainFields.description: The title value before the edit. Null if title was not changed.

plainFields.name: after_title
plainFields.description: The title value after the edit. Null if title was not changed.

plainFields.name: before_description
plainFields.description: The description value before the edit. Null if description was not changed.

plainFields.name: after_description
plainFields.description: The description value after the edit. Null if description was not changed.

plainFields.name: before_startdate
plainFields.description: The start date value before the edit. Null if start date was not changed.

plainFields.name: after_startdate
plainFields.description: The start date value after the edit. Null if start date was not changed.

plainFields.name: before_duedate
plainFields.description: The due date value before the edit. Null if due date was not changed.

plainFields.name: after_duedate
plainFields.description: The due date value after the edit. Null if due date was not changed.
